== Course of events ==

Having grown suspicious of how easily the group progressed toward the palace, and having argued that Jinjur was rightfully Queen with no claim held to occupy her palace, the Scarecrow declares that they cannot stay shut in the palace and calls for a plan of escape. Only the Scarecrow is named as present for this declaration.

The call for a plan sets the stage for what follows: the Scarecrow removes his crown and hands it aside, reflecting that Jinjur may now claim it, an act that marks the abandonment of the palace in favor of the escape the Scarecrow has just called for.
